messages:
Sara Patel: ok kicking off Q3 hosted-api planning — main ask: propose 3 SKU tiers for embeddings + rerank (dev/free, standard, enterprise). need launch criteria and SLA tradeoffs by EOD wed. cc @Juan Morales @Ravi Singh
Juan Morales: quick q — tiers mean different latency SLOs? like 100ms / 200ms / 500ms for embeddings?
Ravi Singh: agree on tiers. also want to tie quantization & model variant recommendations to tiers. enterprise gets dedicated pools + int8, standard uses shared pools + dynamic batching.
Emily Chen: ops note — canary plan + rollback windows required. propose: 2-week canary with 2 enterprise customers, 72h rolling for standard, immediate rollback for any quality regression flagged by eval set.
Ana Rivera: we need autopause + burst policy for standard to cap cost; alerting for sustained qps spikes.
Liam O'Connor: customer ask from ACME: embeddings <150ms 99p and eu-west affinity. they explicitly tied renewal to it. flagging as high priority constraint.
Sara Patel: drafting launch criteria — paste below. please add owners & concrete metrics.
```- Embeddings: 99th percentile latency meets tier target (e.g., dev <=500ms, standard <=200ms, enterprise <=150ms)
- Rerank: throughput and latency p50/p95 targets defined per SKU
- Cost-per-embed estimates validated (unit cost delta <=20% from forecast for standard)
- Regression tests: zero failures on canonical prompt suite across model variants
- Canary: successful canary with two paying customers and automated rollback checks
- Ops: runbook and SLO dashboards in place, alerting thresholds agreed
```
Juan Morales: i'll own the latency benchmarks and batching knobs. i'll add a small script to capture seq-len distribution from production for 7 days.
Ravi Singh: i'll own model profiling & quant recommendations, and a matrix mapping model size/quant to latency+quality tradeoffs.
Emily Chen: i'll own canary and ops playbook, incl. traffic split plan, monitor checklist, and rollback steps.
Ana Rivera: i'll add SLO dashboards, alerts, and a runbook entry for burst/autoscale tuning.
DevOps Bot: infra note — canary cluster provisioning scheduled: 2026-04-05T02:00Z. infra team: please confirm capacity.
Sara Patel: risk list: (1) cost delta for enterprise could be larger than expected; (2) customer-specific SLAs (ACME) may require dedicated region capacity; (3) rerank latency under long seqs unknown. need mitigation for each.
Liam O'Connor: i'll surface ACME ask as potential blocker in the backlog if we can't hit 150ms.
Juan Morales: mitigation idea for (3): run synthetic load for long-seq rerank paths and test KV cache effects. can do next week.
Ravi Singh: mitigation for (1): produce per-token cost model for int8 vs fp16 and include amortized infra fixed costs for dedicated pools.
Emily Chen: mitigation for (2): propose short-term workaround: sticky routing to eu-west for ACME until dedicated capacity ready. ops impact minimal if we limit concurrency.
Sara Patel: owners confirmed. next steps: everyone drop any hard constraints or customer commitments into the doc by EOD Tue. link: https://redwood/internal/roadmaps/hosted-q3-tiling (product+eng edit).
Juan Morales: added initial perf numbers to the doc.
Ravi Singh: added quant notes and a small baseline eval.
Emily Chen: added canary runbook skeleton and traffic split plan.
Ana Rivera: dashboard alert thresholds proposed.
Sara Patel: thanks team. final decision at thurs sync 10am PT. :rocket:
